semantic_routing.description: Semantic routing rules for intelligent file placement
decision_tree: 1. Is there an active TSK and content references it? → tsk/{task_id}/
2. Is this a deliverable proving task completion? → reports/ (or tsk/ if known)
3. Is this reference material for future use? → reports/ or docs/
5. Unknown → allow current path, no suggestion
